tool_args.rationale: Acquire the specified discriminating probe to broaden s_grad leverage and distinguish the open branch before fitting across the full fallback parameter range.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth siphon branch to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot's narrow s_grad span makes vmax and rho nearly collinear, so their separate effects are not identifiable.
The ambiguity concerns gradient leverage and branch choice rather than trajectory resolution; this probe also costs more.
It is irrelevant to the identified ambiguity.
